data.narrative:
DIRAC is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Fil Aronshtein that has raised $5M+. The comparable universe consists of 9 private companies and 1 public company (277810.KQ) operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The valuation analysis applied one reliable method: Stage-Progression. Using DIRAC's $5M total raised as a proxy for base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $12M. Peer-Median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points at the same stage and valuation tier within the narrow robotics peer set—only 1 same-stage comparable was identified across the 10 sector peers surveyed, falling short of the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints required for statistical reliability.

The triangulation yields a range of $11M to $14M, centered at a median of $12M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodology. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x stage-progression multiplier for DIRAC's specific market dynamics and the absence of direct peer comparable trading or funding multiples. A more robust valuation would require either expanded comparable data or supplementary approaches such as venture-backed venture capital method analysis.
